youtube.title: The Sage Who Asked for Rama | Ramayana Ep 4
youtube.description:
A king promised a sage anything he wanted. Then the sage asked for his son. 🏹

The fierce sage Vishvamitra arrived at Ayodhya, and King Dasharatha promised to grant his wish. But the wish was Rama, not yet sixteen, to guard a sacred fire ritual from the demons Maricha and Subahu for ten nights. The king fainted, offered his whole army instead, and refused, until the royal guru Vasishtha reminded him that a king of the Raghu line keeps his word. So Rama left, with Lakshmana at his side, and on the banks of the Sarayu learned the mantras Bala and Atibala.

📜 On screen (Valmiki Ramayana 1.20.2):
"Ūnaṣoḍaśavarṣo me rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ, na yuddhayogyatām asya paśyāmi saha rākṣasaiḥ"
(My lotus-eyed Rama is not yet sixteen; I do not see him fit to fight demons.)

A king promised a sage anything. He asked for his son.

The sage Vishvamitra needed Rama to guard his sacred fire from the demons Maricha and Subahu, for ten nights.
Rama was not yet sixteen. King Dasharatha fainted, then begged him to take his army instead.
The royal guru Vasishtha said: keep your promise; with Vishvamitra, Rama is safe.
So Rama left with Lakshmana, and on the banks of the Sarayu learned the mantras Bala and Atibala.
